explication: PromptPirate is a browser-based 3D avatar controller with an additional Discord age-verification bypass workflow. The primary flow is: a user opens the single-page app, loads a rigged model, configures detected bones and mouth morphs, then drives the avatar through keyboard or gamepad input while viewing it through an orbit camera. A separate QR-based verification branch accepts a URL or image and dispatches either to the hosted API or standalone browser implementation. The UI implementation is documented but not directly sampled.
